setup_walkthrough.what_happens: Establishes a bullish context across Monthly, Daily, and 4H timeframes, identifying a 4H FVG inside a Daily OB.
Observes that the London session formed a low but missed the 4H FVG.
In New York, price sweeps lower into the 4H FVG, forming the low of the day.
Price displaces higher on the 5m, creating an ST model. A 5m overlapping PD array (OB + FVG) forms.
Entry is taken on the retracement into the 5m overlapping OB + FVG. Stop is placed below the 5m intermediate term low after checking 15m context to avoid suffocating it.
